column1: Cook the macaroni according to the package, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Briefly fry the ham in a pan and set aside.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, whisk in the flour, and cook until lightly golden.
Whisk in the evaporated milk and mustard, season with salt and pepper, and cook 3–4 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the milk and three-quarters of the cheese until melted.
Fold in the macaroni and ham, then transfer to a baking dish.
Top with the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake about 20 minutes until golden on top.
